description: The Institut Haïtien de Statistique et d'Informatique publishes the definitive results of the 2003 General Census of Population and Housing on the census pages of its current site, ihsi.gouv.ht. A table page lists the national tables, each shown as an image, and the building and dwelling series cross buildings by type with wall, roof and floor material, and occupied dwellings with connection to a water distribution service, water source, lighting mode, cooking energy, toilets, solid waste disposal and household equipment. The results text, for the country and each department, reports that low houses make up 72.5 percent of buildings and that earth is the most common wall material in rural areas at 33.4 percent, against cement block in towns. Coverage is national. Format and access: free web pages and JPG table images, no registration. Licence: not stated on the pages read. Caveats: tables are images, not data files; the data date from 2003, before the 2010 earthquake; the old domain ihsi.ht now redirects to an unrelated gambling-linked site. Simulation uses: building material and typology baselines for earthquake and hurricane fragility. Related records: a mobility record from Flowminder covers Haiti.

schema_summary: TAB-100 to TAB-103: buildings by type (low house, ajoupa, multi-storey, other) by wall, roof and floor material and urban or rural residence. TAB-104 to TAB-125: occupied individual dwellings by rooms, connection to a water distribution service, water source and use, lighting mode, solid waste disposal, cooking energy, toilet type, telephones, radios, televisions, refrigerators, electric or gas ovens, computers, motorcycles, bicycles and cars in service, tenure, household size.
